title: better life by getting better pvp
body: This mod allows you to block any item you want, gives weakness 1 while holding a mace to make mace pvp more fun and blocks elytras and e-chests while in pvp. Command syntax /limit list > lists all blocked items. /limit (item name) (item amount) > blocks the item of your choosing to the amount of your choosing. /limit remove (item name) > removes set limit for the amount that you wrote.
